partial_smoke_observations.limitations: This record preserves privacy-safe manual findings rather than raw screenshots, prompts, or account data. The Perplexity run proves public-web identity retrieval only after a publisher hint; it does not prove strict-guide compliance. Historical failures are retained so a documentation change cannot be mistaken for behavioral improvement.
